title: Non-pressure ulcer depth and burn extent
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the ulcer, or for the burn extent (T31) when the note is about a burn (only that code).
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for non-pressure chronic ulcer.

HPI
Pt is a 75-year-old female presenting for evaluation of a chronic wound on the right heel. Pt reports the wound has been present for several months. She notes minimal drainage and reports adherence to current wound care regimen. No new systemic symptoms or signs of infection reported.

Medication List
Lisinopril 10mg QD
Atorvastatin 20mg QD
Aspirin 81mg QD

Exam
General: Well-appearing, alert, and oriented.
Vitals: BP 128/78, HR 72, RR 16, Temp 98.6 F, SpO2 98% on RA.
Skin: Exam of the right heel reveals a non-pressure chronic ulcer. The fat layer is exposed. No signs of surrounding erythema or purulent drainage. No bone involvement noted.

Assessment
1. Non-pressure chronic ulcer of the right heel with fat layer exposed.

Plan
1. Wound care: Continue current dressing protocol.
2. Follow-up: Return to clinic in 4 weeks for wound assessment.

Electronically signed,
E. Castillo, DO
10/14/2026
explanations: Non-pressure chronic ulcer of right heel and midfoot with fat layer exposed: L97.412 (HCC 383).

hccs.label: Chronic Ulcer of Skin/Except Pressure/Not Specified as Through to Bone or Muscle
